newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends at new low vs dlr at 1,096.70.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends at new low vs dlr at 1,096.70.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended at a new historic low against the dollar of 1,096.70 -- 2.25 pesos lower than Friday's close -- after falling under pressure from dollar-buying by banks following the three-day holiday weekend, dealers said.
"Banks were oversold," one dealer said, adding that the peso also came under selling pressure when an expected sale of dollars by a major oil exporter failed to materialize.
He and others added that they expected the peso to recoup its losses later this week and settle at about 1,093.00, however.
Dealers reported 381 trades for a total of $207 million and said the peso traded in a broad 1,091.00 to 1,096.95 range.
